fun_facts: Adetomiwa Adebawore was born in Kansas City to Nigerian parents.
A Colts pronunciation guide gives his name as “add-E-TOMMY-wah add-E-BARR-reh.”
At the 2023 combine, he ran the 40-yard dash in 4.49 seconds, jumped 10 feet 5 inches in the broad jump, and reached 37.5 inches in the vertical—all top-10 marks for his position.
In November 2026, Adetomiwa Adebawore recovered a fumble for a touchdown against the Miami Dolphins.
During the 2026 season, he matched his career high of four sacks in just eight games.
